about: Which of Yaarbro's Meshy files holds which clip, for tools/prepare-rigged.py. Times are seconds into the file's own clip. stay: the hips are held over one spot. airborne: a body in the air is brought down to stand on the ground. lift: a body pushed into the ground is lifted out. hands_on_ground: these arms are raised until their hands are not below the ground. parts: two pieces of the clip joined together.
